name: Kenema

queries.query: Kenema Sierra Leone official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS survey department
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Ministry of Lands, Housing and Country Planning (MLHCP) portal, the National Land Commission (NLC) Digital Land Portal, and the Sierra Leone Land Administration Project (SLLAP) site. MLHCP describes land registration and cadastral survey services, while NLC describes interactive cadastral maps as a planned feature. No public anonymous Kenema parcel map/API or parcel geometry was found.

queries.query: Krio: Kenema Salone wata na map parcel land registry official
queries.result: Krio-language discovery did not locate a separate first-party Kenema cadastral viewer or public parcel API. The official MLHCP portal exposes a Krio language link in its header, but the inspected public page did not expose a working Krio route or anonymous map service. The NLC Digital Land Portal remains marked Coming Soon/Under Development.

researchNote: A national land-administration custodian and regional survey/lands mandate are evidenced by official MLHCP/NLC materials, and the MLHCP portal lists land registration and cadastral survey services. This is registry/procedure evidence, not evidence of an open Kenema parcel layer. No safe anonymous native parcel ID plus full polygon geometry was retrieved. This packet records research completion only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
